<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binaryData SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- This is a comment containing CDATA-like markup: <![CDATA[test]]> -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with some markup <tag> &internal; </tag>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

    ]]>
  </m:meta>
</catalog>

  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>

]>

<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">

  <to>&recipient;</to>
  <from>&writer;</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>

      Don't forget to check the CDATA section parsing logic!
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Entity 2 with &e1;">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ENTITY e3 'Macro Entity'>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?debug mode="verbose" level="1"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:ns1="http://doc.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://doc.org/ns2">
  <!-- Comment before sections -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference attempt: &e2;
    ]]>
  </section>
  <ns1:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block with macro entity: &e3;
    ]]>
  </ns1:section>
</document>

<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">

    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&contact;</record>
</archive>
